captions.text: AI insiders reportedly expect / a major AI disaster within a year. / What are they [getting ready]?
captions.plain: AI insiders reportedly expect a major AI disaster within a year. What are they getting ready?

captions.text: Most likely a [cyberattack]: / banks, internet, power, water.
captions.plain: Most likely a cyberattack: banks, internet, power, water.

captions.text: Their reported plan: / brief Congress, and shape / the rules that come [after].
captions.plain: Their reported plan: brief Congress, and shape the rules that come after.

captions.text: One rule on the list: / a required [kill switch].
captions.plain: One rule on the list: a required kill switch.

captions.text: The off switch: [the day after]. / Until then: the sticky note.
captions.plain: The off switch: the day after. Until then: the sticky note.
